name: Mikado
source:
A cat that walks upright and speaks in human language.

He is the "Cat Sith," a mythological fairy creature. He helps the death god/goddess' in their work carrying the souls of the dead to the afterlife.

He was born into royalty in his home world, the cat world, and is quite prideful because of that.

His taste in food is very refined, so he doesn't like eating dry cat food.

[From [url=https://stella.nekonyansoft.com/character.html]official website[/url]]
